notes: Codebuff reads mcp.json from <cwd>/.agents, <cwd>/../.agents and ~/.agents in that order, and a server named again in a later file replaces the earlier one, so ~/.agents/mcp.json wins (V, load-mcp-config.ts:95-100, 175-180; its comment says the reverse). The file is JSON.parse'd (no comments) and each entry is a strict object: stdio {type?: stdio, command, args?, env?} or remote {type?: http|sse, url, params?, headers?}; an unknown key fails the file's schema and every server in it is skipped (V, mcp.ts:3-23, load-mcp-config.ts:150-161). A stdio env value that starts with $ is read whole from the environment, and one that names an unset variable drops the whole file (V, :44-72, 165-173), so derm refuses to write such a reference while the variable is unset. Headers are never expanded, so a header that names a variable is refused. No add command, no managed file found (NF). Codebuff is tier O in note AQ: it has no gate derm can register.
